dataset_info.summary: Clips of “hey mycroft” generated by many different synthetic voices, used as the audio a detector must wake on; the clips it must ignore are pooled from a shared not-wake-word collection of speech, public-domain sounds, environmental audio, music and ambient noise. One row is one clip with its label. Synthesis covers many voices cheaply, but the clips carry no room acoustics and no microphone variation, so this board does not exercise either.
dataset_info.notes: Synthetic 'hey mycroft' positives (TTS across many voices); negatives pooled across the not-wake-word collection (speech, public-domain sounds, ESC-50, music, ambient noise) so false-accept rate spans many scenarios.
